content: GODNA NƗMBA APMA KAVA WULEINJEYA KAVA
Nɨno vɨga lɨgiyanɨn. Godna nyaangɨt kat kai walaa nɨn kat kwutaa wanda apma kava kwolɨneya kava ana wuleigiyanɨn.
Ndi tamba la Juda ndi kat God wan apma nyaangɨt mbutndɨ. Nɨno mɨn kat mbutndɨ. Wan apma nyaangɨt ndi kat ana kwuatndɨ. Ndi kwo waamba wuka kwagalandi. Ana kwutaa lɨndi.

God waa nyaangɨt wutaa kwutaa lɨgiyaa nɨmba mɨna God kwukna apma kava wuleigiyandi. Ndɨna nyaangɨt kat wutaa kai waiga nɨmba wan kava ana wuleigiyandi. Wupma God wandɨ tamba la Juda kat. Kimbut maawupmba lɨga God wandɨ. Wunai kwukna apma kava ana wuleigiyangwuk waa wandɨ God. Wan kava tamba glei kwutndɨ, tɨgandɨ.

God nɨn kat tamba kwutaa kava kwutnyagilaa God kwo lɨndɨ. Tamba la nyan God waa nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutndɨ. Kwutuwa njɨvwa kwutnyagilaa sɨlavɨli wan nandinya kwo lɨgowun waa wandɨ God waa tamba la nyan pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Ndi kat apma vat tɨnjeya kava God kwutndɨ. Ndi wan apma kava ana wuleindi. God ndi kat wandɨ. Ana wuleigiyanguwk wandɨ.
God wan apma kava kwo ana kwutndɨ. ndinyanguwuleilaa tɨnjangat kwutndɨ. Tat ta Juda ndi wan nyaangɨt tak wutndi. Ngi kat tɨga wan kava ana wuleindi.
Nat nɨmba wan kava wuleinjeya njɨmbla kat God wandɨ mala Devit pɨlɨwutndɨ. Tamba Juda ndina angwa kɨpma wuleindi. Ngɨni Devit wan nyaangɨt wupmak kat ke kai waa waa pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Josua tamba Juda kat kwutaa kalinda kɨpma God ndinyangukat kwuta kava ana ndɨ. Kapma kava. Judana kɨpma god ndinyangu wuleinjeya apma kava kat ana pɨlɨwukendɨ.
Godna mbaapmamba lɨga nɨmba wuleinjeya apma kava ngilɨga. Vɨlɨganɨn. Wan kava wuleineya vak kat kawiga lɨganɨn.
Kɨta nyan wan kava wuleilaa ngɨni kɨpmamba nat njɨvwa ana kwukiyandɨ. God njɨvwa kwutaa kwo lɨnda vak vla ndɨno kwo lɨgiyandɨ.
Wan apma kava wuleivat tɨneyan nɨmamba njɨvwa kwuka wuleigiyanɨn. Tamba la ndi Juda kai waa lɨnja vak vla nɨno kaiwalaa wan kava wuleilapman yilanɨn.
Godna nyaangɨt nɨma nyaangɨtna. Avo lɨga nyaangɨtna. Ndɨna ava way vɨlɨlɨk ta bainatna way lɨga vla tɨgandɨ. Nɨna maawupmba lɨga vat sɨga nagulɨgandɨ. Yiga yetɨlɨneya vak kat vɨga lɨgandɨ.
God ndinyanguna maawut tɨgavak aywaa vɨga lɨgandɨ. Nɨn ana alɨpsɨga kɨta vat ndɨ kat pagwugiyanɨn. Ngɨni nɨn kat vaga nɨn kat sɨga naguga aywaa vɨga lɨgiyandɨ.

Nɨn kat sɨga nagundeya vak kat ana vaaka lɨgiyanɨn. Nɨna nɨndɨmba lɨgiyaa nyan ndɨ njambwi nyana. Ndɨ Jisasa. Ndɨ Godna nyana. Nɨna nɨndɨmba lɨga God nɨn kat nyingi maawut tɨnda vak kat kwunakiyandɨ. Judana Hetpris God kat kwunatnja vak vla kwunakiyandɨ. Ngi kat tɨga God nɨn kaat waa nyaangɨt kwutaa lɨna vak ana kwagalgiyanɨn.

Nɨna nɨndɨmba lɨga nyan kapma nyan ana ndɨ. Nɨnagwinala kɨta nyana. Kavle vat yilɨna vak kat vɨlaa nɨn kat nɨmamba miwa yiga lɨgandɨ. Tak nɨnogwinala kɨpmamba yetɨndɨ mala wan kavle vat yila nyan ndɨ kat kavle vat ay wandɨ. Ndɨ kavle vat ana yilɨndɨ. Kavle vat yilɨna vak kat vɨga lɨgandɨ.
Ngi kat tɨga God kat ngambuvak kat ana vaakiyanɨn. Ndɨ kat wagalaneyan yilɨna kavle vat sɨlɨmbwigiyandɨ. Nɨn kat awagapma kwunakiyandɨ yilɨna kavle vak kat.
